```{r}
pacman::p_load(tidyverse, tidymodels, MASS)
```

```{r}
Insurance <- MASS::Insurance
```

```{r}
Insurance_longer <- Insurance %>% 
  pivot_longer(
    cols = c(Claims, Holders),
    names_to = "Hold",
    values_to = "count"
  )
Insurance_longer %>%
  ggplot(aes(x = Age, y = count)) +
  geom_boxplot(show.legend = FALSE,)+
  facet_grid(Hold ~ ., scales = "free_y") +
  theme_minimal() +
  labs(
    x = "Age",
    y = "Count"
  )
```

```{r}
model_1 <- glm(Claims ~ District + Group + Age + log(Holders),family = poisson, data = Insurance)
summary(model_1)
```

```{r}
predict(model_1, type = "response")
```
